text:
maria: Quick sync on Friday's webinar logistics — focus: registration timezone handling, Zoom failover, captions, and post-event clips. Need owners.
tyler: I'll take Zoom ops. Plan: cloud recording auto-start, host+alternative hosts, enable ASR captions, record gallery+speaker. We'll add passcode. For failover, request RTMP endpoint from eng-platform.
ash: I'll own reg page. Include timezone dropdown, utm params (utm_source, utm_campaign), and a checkbox: 'I consent to be recorded and contacted'. Add option 'Send me recording only'.
ben: I'll build post-event workflow. Immediate: thank-you with recording (if opted), 24h: highlight clip + slides, 72h: segmented follow-up. Tag watched_25/50/75 in SFDC. Routing: enterprise domains or senior titles -> AE, else SDR.
eng-platform-bot: Provisioned RTMP: rtmp://rtmp-staging.redwood/stream9. S3 path ready: s3://webinars/1711809999/. Endpoint expires in 6 days.
maria: Small ask on clips: marketing wants 3x lengths (30s, 60s, 90s). During live, we'll drop chat markers like CLIP:HH:MM:SS - short note. Tyler, can you capture timestamps?
tyler: Yep, I'll run 'clip wrangler' and record timestamps to a shared sheet. Also will run a quick RTMP test Tue 10am.
maria: Action list: tyler=Zoom+RTMP test, ash=reg page + consent, ben=nurture + SFDC rules. Dress rehearsal Wed 4pm. Ping when done. :thumbsup:
